title: ever ALYNA|Sparkly Bodice High Low Prom Dresses for Women
descriptionHtml:
Featuring a sexy V neckline, an asymmetric skirt, this shiny high low prom dress is a perfect choice for people who are looking for an elegant look. We think this sparkly high low prom dress is perfect for evening party,cocktail,prom,homecoming,graduation,weddings,and any other formal affair!


Similar Version:High Low Party Dresses


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length: Knee length/High-low.


Closure: It is concealed Zipper up the Back.


Undergarments: It is not Padded , no Lining.


Material: Shell:100%Polyester, 
Lining:100%Polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is No Stretch.
